title: Start Day of the TRICARE Reserve Select Family-Adjustment Relief
content:
**Ledger adjustment ruling - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select.**

The day the family-adjustment relief is counted from follows the purchaser's TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment: where that enrollment is applied or active and its effective date falls inside the period the adjustment covers, the family-adjustment relief is counted from that effective date; where that enrollment is applied or active and its effective date falls before the period the adjustment covers began, the family-adjustment relief is counted from the first day the adjustment covers; otherwise the family-adjustment relief is counted from the plan's termination date.

The period the adjustment covers is the run of days covered by the coverage-type adjustment bills for the most recently paid month (the coverage month of the bill that the latest posted premium payment on the plan settles), ending on the last day of that month. The enrollment is the purchaser's own TRICARE Prime enrollment in the Active Duty Service Member tier, with the status and effective date its record shows; "otherwise" takes in every case where neither of the first two holds.

## Applying the ruling (hypothetical: adjustment covering 20 to 30 June)

| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment | Effective date | Counted from |
|---|---|---|
| active | 24 June | 24 June |
| applied | 12 June | 20 June, the first day the adjustment covers |
| active | 2 July | the plan's termination date |
| any other status, or none | - | the plan's termination date |
